name: Assignment Reminder
postCreateCommand: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y mariadb-server openbox && sudo service mariadb start && sudo mysql -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS assignment_db;" && sudo mysql assignment_db -e "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assignments (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, course VARCHAR(100), due_date DATETIME NOT NULL, priority ENUM('Low','Medium','High') DEFAULT 'Medium', completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE);"
